payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with 2D state dp[i][j] representing longest alternating subsequence ending with elements at indices j and i, using last occurrence tracking for O(n^2) time.
payload.rationale: The solution initializes a 2D table and iterates i, j to compute dp[i][j] via dp[j][p] where p is the most recent index with value equal to arr[i]. This is classic DP with 2D state.
